issues.title: Validate clean Docker installation
issues.body: Start from fresh volumes. Verify health, schema setup and documented local URLs. Record versions and steps. Do not use production data.

issues.title: Verify CasaPay sandbox lifecycle
issues.body: Use synthetic records to verify signing, countersigning, activation, payment webhook, monthly invoice and status sync. Document expected retry behavior and remaining failures.

issues.title: Add demo walkthrough
issues.body: Document one fictional unit, tenant and lease with sanitized screenshots and sandbox-only instructions.

issues.title: Validate Railway deployment and reusable template
issues.body: Follow the deployment guide, verify persistent storage after restart, then test the sanitized template in a fresh project before publishing its URL.

issues.title: Document and test backup restoration
issues.body: Restore both databases, Twenty attachments and sidecar files into an isolated deployment; document commands and recovery checks.

issues.title: Add integration regression coverage
issues.body: Cover duplicate webhooks, payment failures and scheduler retries without live external accounts.
